description: Figure 8 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating the performance (accuracy) of three audio-language models on two benchmarks, MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR. The horizontal axis contains the model categories labeled (left to right) “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70 with tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each model has two adjacent bars: a darker blue bar for “MMAU” and a lighter purple bar for “MMAR,” as indicated by the legend in the upper-left of the plot. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar is approximately 50% and the MMAR bar is approximately 30%; for Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar is approximately 62% and the MMAR bar is approximately 37%; for Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar is approximately 66% and the MMAR bar is approximately 57%. The bars are not shown as explicitly sorted by value, and there are no special visual emphases such as annotations, outlines, or shading beyond the two-color encoding for the benchmarks.
